# Gappu Kids

> Free learning games, one-minute moral story videos, colouring pages and daily kindness missions for kids aged 2 to 8, with Gappu the baby elephant. No ads, no sign-up.

Gappu is a baby elephant in a yellow cap. His friends are Mithu the parrot, Tiku the tortoise and his mother, Amma. Every story teaches one value: helping, sharing, kindness, honesty or a good habit. Made by HiddenHire. Free, with no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

## Story videos
- [All videos](https://gappukids.com/videos/): one-minute moral stories for kids aged 2 to 6, a new one every day
- [The Fire Truck Is Stuck in the Mud!](https://gappukids.com/videos/the-fire-truck-is-stuck-in-the-mud/): Helping Others. Big or small… we can all help!
- [Gappu Dropped His Ice Cream!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-dropped-his-ice-cream/): Sharing. Sharing… makes everyone happy.
- [A Baby Dinosaur Can't Roar!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-dinosaur-cant-roar/): Trying Again. Keep trying… and you'll do it!
- [Gappu's Balloon Is Flying Away!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappus-balloon-is-flying-away/): Kindness. Kind friends… always help.
- [Gappu's Head Is Stuck in a Pumpkin!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappus-head-is-stuck-in-a-pumpkin/): Asking for Help. When you're stuck… ask a friend for help.
- [A Baby Panda Is Stuck in a Bucket!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-panda-is-stuck-in-a-bucket/): Helping Others. Gentle help makes happy friends!
- [Gappu Won't Wash His Hands!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-wont-wash-his-hands/): Keeping Clean. Always wash your hands… before you eat!
- [Gappu Is Stuck in the Mud!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-is-stuck-in-the-mud/): Teamwork. Friends help each other. Together, we're strong!
- [The Tortoise and the Hare!](https://gappukids.com/videos/the-tortoise-and-the-hare/): Never Give Up. Slow and steady wins the race. Never give up!
- [Gappu Won't Go to Sleep!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-wont-go-to-sleep/): Bedtime. Good sleep helps us grow big and strong.
- [A Baby Bunny Is Stuck in a Hole!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-bunny-is-stuck-in-a-hole/): Helping Others. Be a helper, just like Gappu!
- [A Baby Turtle Is Stuck Upside Down!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-turtle-is-stuck-upside-down/): Kindness to Animals. Always help a friend in trouble.
- [Gappu Won't Take a Bath!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-wont-take-a-bath/): Keeping Clean. A bath keeps us clean and happy!
- [A Baby Kitten Is Stuck in a Tree!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-kitten-is-stuck-in-a-tree/): Helping Others. Always help a friend who is scared.
- [A Baby Dinosaur Is Stuck in Its Egg!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-dinosaur-is-stuck-in-its-egg/): Being Gentle. Be gentle with little ones.
- [A Baby Kitten Is Stuck in a Pumpkin!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-kitten-is-stuck-in-a-pumpkin/): Helping Others. When someone is stuck, help them gently.
- [A Puppy Is Scared of Diwali Fireworks!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-puppy-is-scared-of-diwali-fireworks/): Kindness to Animals. Loud bangs scare animals. Be gentle with them.
- [Gappu Won't Eat His Vegetables!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-wont-eat-his-vegetables/): Healthy Eating. Eat your veggies to grow big and strong!
- [A Baby Duck Lost Its Mama!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-duck-lost-its-mama/): Kindness. When someone is lost, help them find home.
- [A Baby Bird Fell From Its Nest!](https://gappukids.com/videos/a-baby-bird-fell-from-its-nest/): Helping Others. Be gentle, and help the little ones.
- [Gappu Won't Brush His Teeth!](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-wont-brush-his-teeth/): Keeping Clean. Brush your teeth every morning and night!
- [One Little Drum for Two Friends](https://gappukids.com/videos/one-little-drum-for-two-friends/): Taking Turns. Take turns, and everyone has fun!
- [Gappu's Kite Gets Stuck](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappus-kite-gets-stuck/): Gratitude. Always say thank you to your helpers.
- [Gappu Finds a Red Ball](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-finds-a-red-ball/): Honesty. Give back what is not yours.
- [Kind or Not? Animal Friends](https://gappukids.com/videos/kind-or-not-animal-friends/): Kindness to Animals
- [Gappu and the Drippy Tap](https://gappukids.com/videos/gappu-and-the-drippy-tap/): Saving Water. Turn off the tap and save every drop!

## Games
- [Kind or Not?](https://gappukids.com/games/kind-or-not/): Listen to what each friend did and decide: kind, or not kind? Read aloud for little ones. (Ages 2+ · good manners)
- [Count with Gappu](https://gappukids.com/games/count/): How many mangoes? Count them up and tap the right number. Gets harder as you go! (Ages 2+ · numbers 1–10)
- [ABC Pop](https://gappukids.com/games/abc-pop/): Find the right letter and pop the bubble! A for Apple, B for Ball — Gappu says every one. (Ages 3+ · letters A–Z)
- [Gappu Memory](https://gappukids.com/games/memory/): Flip the cards and find the pairs — Gappu, Mithu, Tiku and more. Three levels. (Ages 3+ · memory)
- [Mango Catch](https://gappukids.com/games/mango-catch/): Drag Gappu to catch falling mangoes — but watch out for the mud! How high can you score? (Ages 3+ · quick reflexes)
